assertions.subject: Dementia
assertions.quote: global cognitive decline causing functional impairment

assertions.subject: Vascular Dementia
assertions.quote: The most common types of dementia are Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Lewy Body dementia (LBD, a term which includes both dementia with Lewy Bodies (DLB) and Parkinson’s disease dementia), vascular dementia (VaD) and Frontotemporal dementia (FTD)

assertions.subject: Alzheimer’s disease
assertions.quote: the ATN (A = amyloid, T = tau, N = neurodegeneration) framework for the diagnosis of AD

assertions.subject: Lewy Body dementia
assertions.quote: dopaminergic single-photon emission computerised tomography (SPECT) and PET imaging (for DLB)
